user_query: I'm organizing a charity event for my community and I need to make sure that the email addresses on the attendee list are valid. Please use the Check lists API to verify the email addresses. Additionally, fetch the latest article from the test apideno API to share with the attendees and receive notifications for event updates using the Receivenotification API.

TaskList.description: Verify the email addresses on the attendee list using the Check lists API.
Fetch the latest article using the test apideno API to share with the attendees.
Set up notifications for event updates using the Receivenotification API.
